digest.component_or_area: MCP server blue-green deployment and session management
propositions: Blue-green cutover swaps nginx upstream to a new container instantly, orphaning all client sessions rooted in the old container with HTTP 404 Session expired errors
Sessions are stateful and sticky to their originating container; when upstream switches mid-session, the client's next request routes to a container that has never heard of that session

Retired containers are marked for graceful drain with a 21-minute grace period but the nginx upstream is switched immediately, so no further requests reach the old container to drain in-flight sessions
Retired containers accumulate in docker ps as wedged unhealthy instances and the retire command is re-issued every autodeploy tick without actually terminating the container
Clients starting new sessions during the cutover window fail with timeout, and the window extends ~22 minutes while multiple containers coexist
Stateless mode with stateless_http=True is available in the FastMCP SDK and is safe for rebar because no tool imports Context or declares server-initiated messages
